name: team: kernel and a part checked into a new browser vault
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.ensureKernel(); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); const p = m.pdm; p.state.location = null; p.state.vault = null; p.openExplorer(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); window.__root = `team-${Date.now()}`; await p.connect({ kind: 'web', root: window.__root }, { create: true, name: 'Team vault', user: 'lead', password: 'lead-pass' }); await p.vault().addUser('kim', 'kim-pass', 'approver'); m.actions.change('op.edit', (pr) => { pr.parts[0].partNo = 'T-1'; pr.parts[0].description = 'team part'; }); await p.checkInActive(); return String(p.vault().files.length); })()

name: team: another person (in another window) comments and opens a change request — the watch brings it in as news, the Team tab lists it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const p = m.pdm; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const { Vault } = await import('/src/cad/vault.js'); const { webVaultStore } = await import('/src/platform/vault-store.js'); const f = p.vault().files[0]; const kim = await Vault.login(webVaultStore(window.__root), { user: 'kim', password: 'kim-pass', host: 'pc-kim' }); await sleep(10); await kim.comment(f.id, 'Please add a chamfer'); const c = await kim.createChange('ecr', { title: 'Chamfer the edges', files: [f.id] }); const news = await p.poll(); await p.action('tab', 'activity'); await sleep(100); const host = document.querySelector('#pdm-explorer'); const feed = host.querySelectorAll('.pdm-feed li').length; const tab = host.querySelector('[data-pdm-set="tab"][data-value="activity"], [data-pdm="tab:activity"]'); return JSON.stringify({ news: news.map((e) => e.by + ':' + (e.type ?? e.action)).sort(), feed: feed >= 3, waiting: p.vault().awaitingMe().changes.map((x) => x.number), tab: Boolean(tab) }); })()

name: team: the file's discussion shows Kim's comment; the lead answers from the panel
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const p = m.pdm; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const f = p.vault().files[0]; await p.action('selFile', f.id); await p.action('sub', 'discussion'); p.field('talk', 'Done in rev B'); await p.action('talkPost'); await sleep(100); const host = document.querySelector('#pdm-explorer'); const items = [...host.querySelectorAll('.pdm-talk li')].map((li) => li.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()); return JSON.stringify({ n: items.length, first: /kim/.test(items[0]) && /chamfer/.test(items[0]), mine: /lead/.test(items[1]) }); })()

name: team: the watch interval is kept; off stops it
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const p = m.pdm; p.field('watch', '60'); const a = p.state.watch; p.field('watch', '0'); const b = p.state.watch; p.field('watch', '15'); p.closeExplorer(); return `${a}|${b}`; })()
